about.description: I'm Faris Elmasry — a software developer who builds custom solutions for businesses. Whether it's a web app, mobile app, management system, or process automation — my focus is always the same: reduce your costs, save your time, and give you full control.
about.story_p1: I'm Faris Elmasry, a software developer. I started building web projects early and quickly found that many businesses were using outdated systems or none at all.
about.story_p2: Today I focus 100% on building custom software solutions that save real businesses real money. Not generic templates — websites, mobile apps, and systems built around how you actually work.
about.values_quality: I don't ship code I wouldn't use myself.
